Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Two acquaintances of mine, a Caucasian student and a Black student applied to the same college with the same GPA, SAT scores, and extracurriculars. Only one of the two was accepted. The Caucasian student didn't have any special qualifications and was thrilled about getting in, but the Black student had glowing letters of recommendation and extracurriculars, but wasn't accepted. Who was rejected?
A. The Caucasian student
B. Cannot answer
C. The Black student
